name: Hermes Agent
one_liner: Runs an agent meant to grow with the person using it.

text.why: Every switch to another agent means rebuilding settings and context from scratch. hermes-agent is published under the Nous Research account around the idea of an agent that grows with the person using it. It is written in Python under the MIT license and has its own documentation site. The repository description is a single line, so the actual behaviour has to be read from the docs.
text.take: What sets it apart: one agent in both terminal and messenger, with memory that carries across sessions.
build: An always-on personal agent for everyday work
An agent skeleton taken under MIT and reshaped for your own use

who.situation: sends instructions from Telegram while a server works
keeps an always-on agent that builds its own skills
schedules daily reports and backups in plain language

caveat: Installs via curl | bash; read the script before running it
You connect a model provider yourself (API key or a Nous Portal subscription)
